title: Attention Intelligence and the Review Burden of AI-Assisted Work
brief: Attention Intelligence is used here as a working frame for a practical editorial problem: AI can speed up output while making source awareness, review discipline, rights boundaries, and human judgment harder to keep visible.

The fixture supports a narrow claim: an AI-assisted narrative workflow can record where sources entered, which claims were supported, which claims were rejected, and which human review gates occurred before a brief was marked ready.
The fixture does not support stronger claims about curriculum adoption, scientific validation, public publication rights, customer traction, or production-grade automation.
limitations: No credentialed YouTube/API or cloud n8n execution proof.
